investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Cedarfold Freight (freight and logistics); Platform: AWS ap-south-1 (zones ap-south-1a/ap-south-1b/ap-south-1c); network range 10.148.0.0/16; Database: postgres server shipment-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-3e759a5a1269fe638; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
